description: Excessive rainfall / flash-flood outlook (NOAA WPC) — Flash-flood risk for any US point over the next 5 days from the NOAA Weather Prediction Center Excessive Rainfall Outlook: per outlook day the category NONE / MARGINAL (5%+) / SLIGHT (15%+) / MODERATE (40%+) / HIGH (70%+) chance that rain exceeds flash-flood guidance within 25 miles, valid times (UTC, 12Z-12Z), the peak day, a one-line summary and plain-English guidance. Params: lat, lon (decimal degrees, contiguous US). Public-domain US government data. JSON. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_excessive_rain
